The **Construction Management Bachelor of Technology** is a degree-completion program focused on construction-project management, technical, and interpersonal skills.

- **Format:** Full-time or part-time
- **Delivery:** In person at the Burnaby campus
- **Curriculum areas:** construction controls, organizational management, stakeholder engagement, management electives, Liberal Studies, and professional standards

If you want to assess admission eligibility, share your previous credential, GPA, and construction-industry experience.
